grades.upper_bound_mechanism: O = midpoint of AZ; midline theorem gives OM = ZB/2, ON = ZC/2, equal as radii of (BCEF)
grades.notes: Complete and rigorous. Directed-angle translations of all three hypotheses into concyclicity of B,C,E,F; E on (BLN) and F on (CKM), including tangent degenerate cases E=N, F=M.
